pain_point: Fear of buying at the wrong time - What if the market drops after I buy? Should I wait for rates to come down?
headline_outcome: Lock In Today's Price. Settle Later.
primary_text: "What if the market drops after I buy? Should I wait for rates to come down?" Every business owner who waited through the last cycle watched Truganina land values climb 30%+. Here's the thing about off-the-plan: you lock in today's price but don't settle until construction completes. If rates drop before then, you benefit. If values rise, you've already secured your position. Melbourne's western industrial corridor isn't slowing down — demand from logistics and e-commerce is structural, not cyclical. Stop timing the market. Start building equity in a brand-new warehouse.
description: Lock in today's price now and settle when construction completes
